records.title: Facilities at Pune Airport
details: e: To improve passenger convenience at Pune Airport, revamping of the arrival portion of the Old Terminal Building adjacent to the New Integrated Terminal Building is underway, adding about 4,000 sq. m. of passenger area with additional check-in counters, boarding gates and security infrastructure, thereby increasing terminal capacity. For further expansion of Pune Airport, the State Government has been requested to hand over 330 acres of land to Airports Authority of India.

records.title: Financial Assistance to Pimpri Chinchwad
details: b: Land acquisition and DPR preparation are at various stages.
